div.head: Northu 57
div.ab: Se þe freols oððe riht fæsten brece, gilde wite XII ór.
Se þe freols oððe rihtfæsten brece, gilde wite XII or.
Wer Feiertag oder gesetzliches Fasten bricht, zahle Strafe: 12 Ör.
Whoever breaks a feast-day or a lawful fast, let him pay a fine: 12 ores.
He who violates a festival or a legal fast is to pay 12 ores fine.
One who violates a holy day or a legally mandated fast is to pay a penalty of twelve oras.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
